training_design.refit: Train plus validation only after L2 selection; test never used in fitting.

limitations: Historical first availability is not attested. Cards fetched after results may be corrected.
Conditions on final runner field; not an auditable pre-off non-runner simulation.
No prices, betting returns or prospective challenge credit.
Small fixed-date sample; no calibration claim or evidence of betting profitability.
Final-field reconstruction is not a prospective test. Test is single-publisher and exploratory.
Feature definitions and L2 grid fixed before inspecting test metrics. Further tuning requires a new untouched test period.
No SP/odds, editorial ratings or target-race results are used as features.
No going-specific, trainer/jockey or draw model. Course is a sparse past-performance feature only.

performance.selection_policy: Latest archived forecast per race/model, captured at least five minutes before scheduled start.
